title.zh: 选择比终点：停得准比磨得快更重要
title.en: Selectivity and endpoint: accurate stopping matters more than speed

subtitle.zh: 目标膜 /阻挡层/停止层/终点信号
subtitle.en: Target film / barrier / stop layer / endpoint signal

body.zh: 去净该去除的材料；同时保住不该去除的层
body.en: Remove the material that should be removed while retaining layers that must remain

body.zh: 01 CMP终点流程；快速主抛；去除大部分目标膜
body.en: 01 CMP endpoint flow Rapid bulk polishing Remove most of the target film

body.zh: 接近材料界面；信号开始发生变化
body.en: Approach the material interface The signal begins to change

body.zh: 读取终点信号；检测到界面特征
body.en: Read the endpoint signal Detect interface features

body.zh: 切换或停止；切换到轻抛或停止
body.en: Switch or stop Switch to soft polishing or stop

body.zh: 必要过抛；膜厚验证；去除残留，保证全局 确认终点与一致性
body.en: Required overpolish Validate thickness Remove residues for global clearance; confirm endpoint and consistency

body.zh: 02 关键控制因素；材料选择比；目标膜与停止层的；去除速率差异，决定终点窗口
body.en: 02 Key control factors Material selectivity The removal-rate difference between target and stop layers defines the endpoint window

body.zh: 终点信噪比；界面信号清晰、稳定；抗噪能力强
body.en: Endpoint signal-to-noise ratio Clear, stable interface signal Strong noise rejection

body.zh: 过抛时间；适当的过抛确保全局去除；但需避免下层损伤
body.en: Overpolish time Appropriate overpolish ensures global clearance while avoiding damage to underlying layers

body.zh: 剩余膜厚窗口；保留足够的停止层厚度；以保证工艺裕量
body.en: Remaining-thickness window Retain sufficient stop-layer thickness to preserve process margin

body.zh: 不同终点状态的结构与信号；目标膜；阻挡层；停止层；衬底
body.en: Structure and signal at different endpoint states Target film Barrier Stop layer Substrate

body.zh: 抛光前；目标膜较厚
body.en: Before polishing Thick target film

body.zh: 终点过早；残膜存在；未完全去除目标膜
body.en: Endpoint too early Residual film remains Target film is not fully removed

body.zh: 正确终点；停在停止层；去除充分且无损伤
body.en: Correct endpoint Stop on the stop layer Complete removal without damage

body.zh: 终点过晚；损伤下层；下层被过度去除
body.en: Endpoint too late Damages underlying layers Underlying layers are excessively removed

body.zh: 典型终点信号曲线；过早；（残膜）；正确；终点；过晚；（损伤）；抛光时间
body.en: Typical endpoint-signal curve Too early (residual film) Correct endpoint Too late (damage) Polishing time

body.zh: 终点检测方式；时间；基于经验的；时间控制
body.en: Endpoint detection methods Time Experience-based time control

body.zh: 光学；反射/散射/；干涉等光学信号
body.en: Optical Reflection / scattering / interference and other optical signals

body.zh: 电涡流；检测导电层的；电学变化
body.en: Eddy current Detect electrical changes in conductive layers

body.zh: 设备信号；电机功率/扭矩/；声发射等
body.en: Equipment signals Motor power / torque / acoustic emission, etc.

body.zh: 按材料与设备选用，并非全部同时适用
body.en: Choose for the material and equipment; not all methods apply simultaneously

body.zh: 常见失效模式；终点过早；残膜导致；电性开路风险
body.en: Common failure patterns Endpoint too early Residual film creates risk of an electrical open

body.zh: 终点过晚；下层损伤；Dishing与；Erosion加剧
body.en: Endpoint too late Underlying-layer damage Dishing and erosion worsen

body.zh: 信号漂移；过程不稳定；误判终点
body.en: Signal drift Unstable process Endpoint misidentification

body.zh: 局部残膜；全局合格；但局部残留
body.en: Local residual film Globally acceptable but locally incomplete

body.zh: 量测反馈闭环；终点曲线；（过程信号）；剩余膜厚；（晶圆面内）；截面形貌；（验证结构）；电性复核；（接触电阻/连通性）；数据分析•工艺优化•稳定控制
body.en: Closed-loop metrology feedback Endpoint curve (process signal) Remaining thickness (across the wafer) Cross-sectional morphology (structure validation) Electrical cross-check (contact resistance / continuity) Data analysis · process optimization · stable control

body.zh: 下游影响；决定导线厚度、；介质完整性、；接触电阻和图形可制造性
body.en: Downstream impact Determines conductor thickness, dielectric integrity, contact resistance and pattern manufacturability

body.zh: 重要边界；并非所有结构都能获得；清晰在线终点信号
body.en: Important boundary Not every structure provides a clear in-situ endpoint signal

body.zh: 信号强度
body.en: Signal intensity
